verdict.rationale: YYLO documents an official CLI (`@yylo/cli`), YAML workflows and installable Skills, but nothing in the evidence describes an official programmatic SDK or client library to build against. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The CLI and Skills are adjacent features, not SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
